structural_growth_runway.rationale: Q2營收年增50%至115.36億美元，資料中心占58%；公司預期Q3營收約130億美元（±3億）且資料中心下半年加速，支持AI與高效能運算的成長續航。

Retains SBC net of assumed issuer normalized 13% tax rate; inventory reserve adjustment not repeated. Cash flow crosscheck adds SBC back and is not owner earnings.

circle_of_competence.rationale: 個人是否充分理解企業硬體、AI伺服器毛利與供應鏈循環，保留在正式建倉前由使用者確認；不阻擋研究排名。

valuation.rationale: Issuer EPS guidance with full investment-gain stress removal; retains recurring costs.
